description: This file defines configuration types, default settings, and functions for resolving and merging configuration options for a Playwright-based browser testing setup. It includes handling of CLI options, environment variables, and file-based configs, as well as utility functions for parsing and sanitizing input.

methods.name: resolveConfig
methods.description: Merges default configuration with a provided Config object to produce a FullConfig.

methods.name: resolveCLIConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from CLI options, environment variables, and config files, merging them into a FullConfig.

methods.name: configFromCLIOptions
methods.description: Converts CLIOptions into a Config object, handling validation and parsing.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON configuration file asynchronously.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Generates a sanitized output file path based on configuration, root path, and filename.

methods.name: pickDefined
methods.description: Creates a partial object containing only defined properties from the input object.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges a base FullConfig with overrides from a Config object, producing a new FullConfig.

methods.name: semicolonSeparatedList
methods.description: Splits a string by semicolons into an array of trimmed strings.

methods.name: commaSeparatedList
methods.description: Splits a string by commas into an array of trimmed strings.

methods.name: dotenvFileLoader
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a dotenv file.

methods.name: numberParser
methods.description: Converts a string to a number, or returns undefined if invalid.

methods.name: headerParser
methods.description: Parses a header string into a key-value pair and adds it to a record.

methods.name: envToBoolean
methods.description: Converts environment variable string to boolean if possible.

methods.name: envToString
methods.description: Trims and returns environment variable string.

methods.name: sanitizeForFilePath
methods.description: Sanitizes a string for safe use as a filename by replacing unsafe characters with hyphens.
